input: Learn the basics of home electrical wiring safely

gold.taskTitle: Learn Home Electrical Wiring Basics Safely
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to build foundational knowledge and skills in home electrical wiring while prioritizing safety practices.

questions.title: What is your current electrical knowledge starting point?
questions.description: Understanding the user's baseline knowledge helps calibrate the learning path, from complete beginner to someone with some DIY experience.

questions.title: Which specific wiring tasks do you want to learn?
questions.description: Identifying target tasks such as replacing outlets, installing switches, running new circuits, or reading wiring diagrams focuses the plan on what matters most.

questions.title: Do you want to do real work or just understand concepts?
questions.description: Clarifying whether the goal is purely theoretical understanding or hands-on practical execution shapes the type of resources and practice needed.

questions.title: What country and type of home do you live in?
questions.description: Electrical standards, codes, and wiring conventions vary significantly by country and also differ between older homes and new construction.

questions.title: How much time per week can you dedicate to this?
questions.description: Knowing the available time commitment helps structure a realistic schedule and decide between intensive or gradual learning approaches.

questions.title: Do you prefer learning from videos, books, or hands-on practice?
questions.description: Matching resources to the user's preferred learning style increases retention and keeps them engaged throughout the process.

questions.title: Are there permits or inspections required in your area?
questions.description: Many jurisdictions require permits for electrical work beyond minor repairs, which directly affects what the user can legally do themselves.
